segments: The things that can stall Seeds of Doubt later if you ignore them during the early rounds.

Do these alongside power, Pack-a-Punch, and skull setup. The goal is to arrive at the three-cog stage with every player’s Trials complete and the specialist, shield, gas mask, and Masamune progression already handled.
Have these covered before the endgame
Bring this GobbleGum into the game. It is required for the hidden-room cog.
Each player must complete their own three challenge tablets during setup; everyone finishing their Trials also unlocks the lightning used for the electrified-shield cog step.
Clean all four skulls and finish the Keeper encounter so Mesmerize is available for hidden quest objects.
Build the KT-4, then complete the upgrade ingredients before the elevator/boss stretch.
Build it during setup and keep a usable shield for the electrified zipline cog.
Build one during setup and replace it with a fresh mask before the elevator descent.
Keep the bucket and seeds moving through the colored-water plant steps instead of leaving them until the end.
